digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend comment handling
propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling to 32767 chars, ignoring Jira Data Center's admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property (range 0–2147483647)
comments longer than hardcoded 32767 but within an admin-configured higher limit are silently truncated, causing permanent local/remote body divergence
sanitize_comment reuses the description fitter fit_outbound, creating coupling risk where future description-fitting changes could incorrectly retarget comment truncation logic
the configuration layer exposes /rest/api/2/application-properties read-only to administrators, not to rebar's ordinary-user PAT, making runtime endpoint discovery infeasible
the constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is misattributed in comments to Cloud comment limits when its provenance is jira.text.field.character.limit via JRASERVER-28519
